label: Generic ITAD JSON search (template)
notes: Starting point for any ITAD house that exposes a JSON search endpoint. Copy this file, rename the id, and fill in url / itemsPath / map from the site's own network requests.
Field specs accept a bare path ("title"), or an object with path/regex/template/const plus optional transform (text, money, date, int, number, bool, lower, upper) and baseUrl for relative links.
